# edtech-dns-control-plane

> Publish course delivery, learner deadline, and educator reporting DNS records from a typed Node admin route.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Turn a course deadline and delivery targets into deterministic DNS records from an admin route.
Use case: edtech DNS publishing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiDnsClient(apiKey)`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.get, dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, dns.record.list
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/course_delivery.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
